verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas Engine is open-source (MIT, installable via npm), and paid plans offer "Download Apps for Self-hosting", so the runtime and built apps can be run on your own infrastructure. However, the Editor, a central part of the product, is documented as browser-based with work saved to their cloud, and community reports say code must live on PlayCanvas servers with no offline editor. missing for 10: self-hostable Editor/backend, documented self-hosting deployment guide, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
